prod.how: Push to origin/main, then use the registered carbon-forge deployer to sync and update only the Forge orchestrator on super_server.

prod-voxcpm.run: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; if (!(Test-Path 'C:\Programming\ForgeVoxCPM\.git')) { git clone https://github.com/CarbonNode/Carbon-Forge.git C:\Programming\ForgeVoxCPM; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; Set-Location C:\Programming\ForgeVoxCPM; git fetch origin main; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git checkout --detach {ref}; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & .\scripts\deploy-voxcpm.ps1 -Ref {ref}"
prod-voxcpm.how: Build the pinned VoxCPM2 worker in its own checkout on laybackrig, download public weights without model loading, start only carbon-forge-voxcpm, and require health. Does not edit the old GPU checkout or restart Chatterbox, CHIM or the orchestrator. GPU generation is a separate smoke test and refuses a busy GPU.

notes: The prod environment updates the orchestrator. prod-voxcpm deploys the isolated VoxCPM2 worker. Verify a real speech clip separately; worker health is not generation proof.
